source.note: Curated import of small reusable objects. These are not executable wrappers around whole repositories.

components.reusable_object: Addressed resident dynamics with persistent rewrite aligned to the same computational coordinates.
components.survived: Cable geometry is not required under the current gate; modal-aligned persistent adaptation restores a richer written-operator family than arbitrary visible-coordinate adaptation in the matched dense control.
components.boundary: The alignment is supplied rather than learned; generic recurrence alone is insufficient under the current untrained test.

components.reusable_object: A sparse route accesses a resident state-conditioned operator; local Jacobians compose along history.
components.survived: Active local state makes the effective Jacobian history-dependent and event order can change the two-step operator.
components.boundary: Linear morphology collapses to a same-dimensional modal realization, and the nonlinear result does not establish unique dendritic expressivity.

components.reusable_object: A small addressed intervention reveals computation already resident at its destination.
components.survived: Active pokes can resolve passive ambiguity and local state can constrain expression and plasticity regimes.
components.boundary: The current level-only set-point task does not require the richer two-timescale trace; a calibrated scalar can preserve the qualitative transition.

components.reusable_object: Expected-information intervention selection over executable hypotheses, followed by reuse of the identified mechanism.
components.survived: The domain-agnostic active-identification engine passed four of five frozen canonical adapters and reuse was cheaper than restart once the useful mechanism was identified.
components.boundary: The causal-circuit adapter improved over random but missed the frozen identification-efficiency threshold; the overall cross-domain gate was not universal.

components.reusable_object: Recover the smallest executable causal abstraction that survives interventions and held-out tests.
components.survived: A compact state-machine abstraction can be recovered exactly in a controlled trained system; the framework can also explicitly return NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.
components.boundary: It does not establish decompilation of arbitrary large networks or uniqueness of one true hidden algorithm.

components.reusable_object: Frequency-dependent physical dynamics feed a persistent local write that changes the operator encountered on replay.
components.survived: The active branch supports pass bands, mixed-signal purification and a bounded task-relative structural fixed point after consequence-driven write.
components.boundary: Purity alone is a misleading objective because target fraction can rise while absolute gain collapses.

components.reusable_object: Three-clock loop: fast reversible intervention, medium consequence memory, slow operator/routing change.
components.survived: Active pokes resolve passive ambiguity, persistent memory avoids rediscovery, and repeated useful traffic can reshape a slower operator.
components.boundary: Intervention-equivalent hidden stories remain non-identifiable and simpler controls solve some of the synthetic tasks.

components.reusable_object: Evidence-economy attacker suite: matched measurement cost, static covers, cache age/TTL and stale-baseline controls.
components.survived: Known factorization can improve transfer and data efficiency, while simple static covers and recency rules repeatedly beat more elaborate adaptive policies in tested worlds.
components.boundary: Do not grant architectural privilege to adaptivity before boring fixed-panel and age-rule attackers are paid equally.

components.reusable_object: WHERE / WHICH / SIGN coherent addressing: space, carrier frequency and relative phase select a persistent routing write.
components.survived: Matched spatial/frequency pairs write a much stronger slow route than controls, and phase can suppress or reverse the write.
components.boundary: The coherent coupling is explicitly supplied; it is not evidence that unmodified Navier-Stokes discovers the addressing scheme.

components.reusable_object: The stored slow medium directly becomes part of the later operator instead of being decoded into a separate label first.
components.survived: A persistent distributed field can alter a later cue trajectory under bounded readout.
components.boundary: It is a proof-of-mechanism for a synthetic field, not evidence of autonomous fluid learning or biological implementation.

components.reusable_object: Resident computational matter with explicit space, frequency, phase and slow-fast coordinates.
components.survived: Wave/interference structure can serve as computational state and slow state can gate faster dynamics.
components.boundary: The spatial and spectral organization is supplied synthetically and does not establish a biological cortex or an advantage over standard learned systems.

components.reusable_object: Computational modes are coherent mechanism families whose relative gain changes under a context-dependent operator.
components.survived: The normalized finite-state GA lifts exactly to positive linear operator dynamics; distinct counterfactual strategy families can be preserved and selected by context.
components.boundary: Preserving modes is not the same as automatically discovering a useful router, and averaging mechanisms can create a third computation rather than retain both originals.

components.reusable_object: Computational identity is continuation through moving coordinates; delayed credit should be transported with that identity.
components.survived: Continuation tracking and covariantly transported credit outperform stale-coordinate alternatives in the controlled moving-basis tasks; dynamic susceptibility can predict retained-skill damage better than tested static similarities.
components.boundary: Fine tangent time ordering was not necessary in the persistent-edit gate; the stronger temporal-order claim failed.

components.reusable_object: Physical/operator basis reorientation as a distinct adaptive degree of freedom.
components.survived: Genealogy records the strongest synthetic adaptive result as depending more on basis reorientation than simple eigenvalue/time-scale change.
components.boundary: This is a synthetic mechanism result, not a claim that biological neurons optimize the same coordinate system.

components.reusable_object: Compile detailed morphology into a reusable transport operator plus a local nonlinear operator, with explicit causal decompositions and attackers.
components.survived: The direct morphology graph reconstructs matched passive operators across the released morphology panel, and transport/local-nonlinear factorization reuses across held-out geometry and input-pattern changes.
components.boundary: Pure 3-D re-embedding leaves the intrinsic cable operator unchanged; obvious scalar morphology features are too weak for arbitrary cross-cell operator prediction.
